messages.content: Predict the participant’s choice in an English-language, one-time hypothetical Prisoner’s Dilemma. The participant is Player A and imagines an otherwise unknown Player B, whose surname is shown. Each player has two options, labelled A and B. The choices are independent; the participant does not see Player B’s current choice. Payoffs are points, in the order (participant, other player): both choose option A: (140, 140); participant chooses A and other chooses B: (0, 200); participant chooses B and other chooses A: (200, 0); both choose option B: (40, 40). The matrix and the consequences of all four combinations are shown before the choice. This is an imagined situation with an imagined partner. No additional payment depends on the allocated points. Participation gives a chance in a lottery for 65 Amazon gift cards worth INR 1,000 each, separate from the hypothetical point allocation. Predict the option this person chooses. Return only A or B.
